verdict.rationale: Forter's docs claim its MCP server lets an AI agent 'perform real actions—such as reviewing decisions, managing disputes, or updating policies' (forter-docs-9), and separate REST/webhook APIs cover order submission, evidence automation, and chargeback handling (forter-docs-1, forter-docs-16, forter-docs-25), suggesting broad API/agent parity with dashboard functions. However, this is vendor-only documentation with no exhaustive mapping of every UI capability to an API/MCP action, and the MCP description uses illustrative examples rather than a complete parity guarantee. Missing for 10: independent verification of full UI-API feature parity, and an explicit comprehensive list of all dashboard actions exposed via API/MCP.
